grid_vs_official_global.note: Cos(lat)-weighted mean of the OBSERVED grid cells vs the source's own published global mean. They differ because the publishers weight, infill and handle coverage differently and because early HadCRUT5 coverage is incomplete. Reported, not hidden: the site uses the published series for headline numbers, not the grid mean.

trend_ci_simulation.note: SYNTHETIC-NOISE method check, not data: AR(1) noise (phi 0.5, innovation sd 0.1 C) plus a known linear trend, 50 years, 95% intervals. Shows how often each interval covers the true slope. Naive OLS undercovers; the AR(1)-adjusted interval (primary) is close to nominal; HAC is in between at this short length.
